senses.gloss: , m. (enlargement of קֶרֶן) mallet; smith’s hammer (v. Sm. Ant. s. v. Malleus).
units: <cite ref="Mishnah Kelim 29:6">Kel. XXIX, 6</cite> (<cite ref="Mishnah Kelim 29:7">7</cite>) <he>הק׳ של זהבים</he> (ed. Dehr. <he>נוס …</he>) the goldsmiths’ hammer; <cite ref="Shabbat 123a:6">Sabb. 123ᵃ</cite>.
<cite ref="Shabbat 123a:6">Ib.</cite> <he>ק׳ של בַּשָּׂמִים</he> the spice-dealers’ mallet.

<cite ref="Tosefta Avodah Zarah 5:7">Tosef. Ab. Zar. V</cite> (<cite ref="Tosefta Avodah Zarah 6:7">VI</cite>), 7 <he>עד שיכה בק׳ ויחבל</he> (not <he>ויאכל</he>) until he strikes upon it with the hammer and batters it. Y. ib. IV, 43ᵈ bot. <he>מתרין בו על כל ק׳ וק׳</he> he is forewarned at every stroke of the mallet (with which he chisels the idol).

<cite ref="Yalkut Shimoni on Torah 369:7">Yalk. Ex. 369</cite> <he>מעשה ק׳</he> beaten work; a. fr.—[<he>קורנסין</he>, <cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 58">Gen. R. s. 58</cite> Ar., v. <cite ref="S01350"><he>קְלִירוֹס</he></cite>.]
